claim_text: Improve water management by enhancing operational efficiency and water accounting
metric_name: Water abstracted (FY25 vs FY24); Processing water use per tonne of spodumene (FY25 vs FY24)
context_text: Water management Zero major water-related incidents Target achieved in FY25 Target continues year-on-year Improve water management by enhancing operational efficiency and water accounting 5.1GL of water was abstracted, increasing 19% from FY24 and processing water use improved to 3.37kL/t of spodumene from 3.74kL/t in FY24.；Water is a critical resource, essential to ecosystem health, community wellbeing and the long-term sustainability of our operations.；Water abstracted increased 19% from 4.3GL in FY24. Processing water use per tonne of spodumene improved from 3.74kL/t in FY24 5.1GL 3.37kL/t.；Engaged third party to develop real-time water dashboards that monitor borefield usage and compliance with licensed limits, flag trigger level exceedances and present a site-wide water balance. Telemetry has been retrofitted to all production bores at the Pilgangoora Operation, enabling remote control and supporting real-time water balance development.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 单位产品加工水耗从3.74降至3.37 kL/t，能支持“operational efficiency”改善，但总取水量上升19%，且“water accounting”更多体现为系统建设而非直接绩效结果，因此仅部分支撑。
notes: 证据合并自第41页目标进展表与第78页水管理章节。
